[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15455/15455-1676147134-1988115118.jpeg[/img][/url]

[spoiler]This mod only changes the upper room via the vanilla farmhouse2 / farmhouse2_marriage, and reapplies cellar stairs (so reloading from title wouldn't be necessary whenever [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is used to config the upper room, [i][u]if you don't use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and reload game for config updates, ignore this.[/u][/i])

[color=#f6b26b][b]Extra information:[/b] [/color][color=#9fc5e8]when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is used to config the bathroom, it loads farmhouse2 / farmhouse2_marriage without applying the cellar stairs (the [b]cellar[/b] itself remains [b]unaffected[/b]/[b]unchanged[/b] as you left it - this has been [b]confirmed via wren greenhouse's warp hatch to cellar ladder[/b]), reloading from title sets your farmhouse back as it was - but with the updated config choices. Added renovations/modular rooms = [b]south room[/b]/[b]north east corner room[/b] were [b]unaffected[/b] by this.

In order to [b]negate[/b] the [b]extra step of reloading from title[/b] [u]per saved config modification via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/u], this mod [b]includes reapplication of cellar stairs[/b] if there's a cellar present.[/color][/spoiler]

[b][size=4] Features [/size][/b]
 [list]
[*]The bathroom is fully functional and will restore your stamina and health. [b][color=#f6b26b]Change to swimsuit[/color], [color=#e06666]enter pool[/color], [color=#f6b26b]change out of swimsuit[/color]; behind frosted door[/b]
[*]You can refill your watering can, at [b][color=#9fc5e8]basin[/color][/b] and [b][color=#9fc5e8]bathtub[/color][/b]
[*]Right-click toilet = warp to [b][color=#00ff00]sewer[/color].[/b]
[*]Breathing skylight animation for the full panel display
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22567]Aqua Window (CP)[/url] functional fish tank - [u]allows duplicates but limited[/u] to 7 per tank (fish + ground + deco + other) ([b]unless[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11388]Increased Fish Tank Capacity[/url])
[/list]
